Expansion.description: Recursively expands all context terms into absolute IRIs and wraps values in value objects.

Compaction.description: Transforms an expanded document into a more compact form using a specific context.

Flattening.description: Flattens nested JSON-LD trees into a single-level array of node objects with forward references.

Framing.description: Structures a JSON-LD document based on a template or 'frame'.
